_meta.method: Each track's coverage status is derived from the task_catalog's per-task dataset_coverage_status and eligibility_status, cross-referenced against dataset_statistics.json and split_audit.json counts. Nothing here is asserted without a specific record-count citation.

tracks.evidence: 2000 arithmetic + 660 sentiment + 400 QA agent_task records, each with agent_output.is_correct ground truth and family-specific confidence fields. All 3 minimum-sample thresholds (500/300/300) are met or exceeded.

Same 3,060 agent_task records support a hypothetical post-hoc ABSTAIN/ANSWER policy simulation (is_correct exists to score it), but the ingested dataset contains 0 actual ABSTAIN-decision episodes (dataset_statistics.json by_decision_type has no ABSTAIN key) and 0 realized RETRY events at the per-episode grain, so no real abstention POLICY was ever executed and observed end-to-end in these records — only simulate-a-policy-post-hoc evaluation is possible.
tracks.limiting_factor: No ABSTAIN/RETRY episodes exist in ingested raw sources (Phase 5.2 limitation 4).

tracks.evidence: controlled_runtime failure-class counts: PROCESS_OOM=10, PROCESS_TIMEOUT_CPU=1, GENERIC_FAIL=13, NETWORK_FAILURE=11 (dataset_statistics.json by_failure_class) — every family is below the 300-sample minimum, and 0 resource_unavailable-labeled records exist at all. The STRONG_EVIDENCE (resource_unavailable) and NOT_VALIDATED (cpu/oom/flaky) verdicts are aggregate-only Phase 4 findings with no per-episode join key ingested into this dataset (Phase 5.2 limitation 5).
tracks.limiting_factor: Insufficient per-episode failure-class sample sizes; aggregate-only source evidence for the headline verdicts.

tracks.evidence: 46 controlled_runtime records carry diagnosis/failure fields, but per-failure-class counts are small (e.g. PROCESS_TIMEOUT_CPU n=1) and no independent causal ground truth exists beyond failure_class matching.
tracks.limiting_factor: Small n per failure class; no causal ground truth beyond failure_class proxy.

tracks.evidence: 34 NOT_RECOVERED + 1 UNKNOWN validation_status records exist in the 46-record controlled_runtime track (dataset_statistics.json). The historical RECONFIGURE-vs-RETRY n=40-per-action comparison is not re-derivable at that scale from this dataset alone.
tracks.limiting_factor: 46-record controlled_runtime scope is below the historical per-action comparison's own sample size.

tracks.evidence: workloads=3104 for episodes=3106 (dataset_statistics.json) means at most a handful of records anywhere share a workload_id, and none are documented as the deliberate Step 6 repeated-incident design. No memory-write timestamps exist (memory_used is boolean-only, Phase 5.2 limitation 3).
tracks.limiting_factor: No repeated-workload_id structure at scale; no memory-write timestamps.

tracks.evidence: environments: 1 (dataset_statistics.json); all 3,106 records carry identity.environment_id == UNSPECIFIED_PRE_4_9 (split_audit.json environment_axis_check, status DISCLOSED_LIMITATION_NOT_APPLICABLE). No per-episode Phase-4.9 EnvironmentId exists anywhere in this dataset.
tracks.limiting_factor: Single represented environment; no per-episode environment_id (Phase 5.2 limitation 2).

tracks.evidence: Only the 46 controlled_runtime records exercise the full observe->decision->diagnosis->recovery->validation->memory loop; agent_task records (3,060) exercise only observe->uncertainty->decision(answer). A full 8-stage claim is limited to n=46.
tracks.limiting_factor: Full-loop coverage confined to the 46-record controlled_runtime slice.
